text: The Seifert-van Kampen theorem is used to compute π₁ of a space formed by gluing two path-connected spaces along:
explanation: Van Kampen: if X = A ∪ B with A, B, A∩B path-connected and open, then π₁(X) = π₁(A) *_{π₁(A∩B)} π₁(B) (amalgamated free product). Requires path-connected intersection.
